findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: There is a massive leak at the handwashing sink in the back dish room. The PIC mentioned that the facility is aware of the leak. It appears that two pieces of piping have been disconnected, causing a gap for contaminated water to leak onto the floor. Ensure that the sink is repaired by a licensed plumber. Will follow-up on July 20, 2026 to ensure that plumbing has been repaired and is in leak free condition.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(A) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Both bathroom handsinks were observed with a small gap between the wall and the back of the hand-sink. The current caulk has peeled from the wall and is need of re-caulking. See that both sinks are re-caulked to prevent debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
There was debris accumulation observed in the following areas:
- food debris on the shelf of the prep table in front of the pizza oven (where to go boxes are stored)
- debris underneath triple sink
- debris underneath storage rack across from triple sink

Shown to PIC. Discussed cleaning floors and hard to reach areas as frequent as necessary to keep them clean. Ensure to educate all staff members on proper cleaning.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
There were several missing floor tiles in the following areas:
- a couple of missing floor tiles around the mop sink
- a missing tile near the back door
- a missing tile near the pieces of laundry equipment 

Ensure that missing floor tiles are replaced to prevent ponding water or debris accumulation in the above mentioned areas.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
Observed a bottle of sanitizer to be stored on a ledge above the prep cooler. Discussed with PIC and the bottle was placed on a shelf away from open food. Ensure that poisonous chemicals are stored in a manner that protects against contamination. 

7-201.11: (A)-(B) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be stored to prevent contamination of FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES by separating or locating MATERIALS in area away or below FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES (use partition or store below).

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
There is a leaking pipe at the handwashing sink along the cook-line. The leaking pipe must be repaired. Ensure that pipes are maintained and are in leak-free condition. 

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Employee observed to wash hands then turn the faucet off without using a barrier (eg, paper towel) to turn the faucet off. CORRECTED- Discussed with employee, who used proper procedure during their next hand-washing. Ensure employees use a paper towel to turn the faucet off after washing hands.
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. [P]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
No paper towels are available at the back handwashing sink near the 3 compartment sink. CORRECTED- Employee provided paper towels. Ensure paper towels are always available at all handwashing sinks.
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. [Pf]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Sanitizer bucket observed with no measurable sanitizer concentration. CORRECTED- Sanitizer bucket was remade and observed at PPM quat. Ensure sanitizer buckets are prepared prior to beginning any food prep, refreshed as needed throughout service, and discarded at the end of service each day. 
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. [Pf]

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
Cookline handwashing sink has a constant leak from the faucet even when it is turned off. Repair the leak.
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
1) Trim tile are damaged throughout the kitchen, including but not limited to: a) between the mop sink & the 3 compartment sink; b) to the left of the laundry machines; c) near the cookline handwashing sink; and d) behind racks to the left of the back door. Repair trim tiles so that the floors are sealed to the wall, and the surface is smooth and easily cleanable.
2) Handwashing sink in the womens restroom is no longer sealed to the wall. Recaulk to close the gap.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed many foods in the walk in cooler and the prep cooler being held at temperatures between 55F and 60F. The walk in cooler and prep cooler were not functioning properly. Food must be maintained at 41F and below. The food was discarded during the inspection. An order of destruction form documented foods discarded. 

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
Observed the walk in cooler and the top of the prep cooler line to be maintaining a temperature of 55-60F. The bottom of the prep coolers were functioning properly and maintained a temperature between 36F and 40F. All foods in the walk in cooler and the top of the prep coolers were discarded. A technician stated the compressor was blown. They are working on getting a new compressor so they can diagnose any other problems with the walk in cooler. A 3 day follow-up is issued because most food is stored in the walk in cooler. 

4-301.11: EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text: 750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the mop stored inside old mop water. After use, mop water must be discarded. Mops must be hung in a position that allows them to air dry. Mop was moved, and mop water was dumped during the inspection. 
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
Observed employee drinks stored in the walk in cooler above sauce. Ensure employee drinks are stored in a designated area where food, equipment, or food-contact surfaces will not be contaminated. 
6-403.11: (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use tobacco shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be located in a designated room or area where contamination of FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES cannot occur.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14  (Pf) No sanitizer solutions were observed during the inspection. Ensure sanitizer is prepared and used to clean all food contact surfaces. Sanitizer solutions made during the inspection. Reference 4-302.14.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16  (C) Observed the mop head stored sitting inside the mop sink. Mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.  Reference 6-501.16.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text: 750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.

findings.title: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures & records
findings.citation_text: 3-501.19  (Pf) Pizza sauce is out of temperature control at 67 °F. The PIC could not produce effective written time control policy. The facility currently uses an 8-hour time control policy for pizza sauce. Discussed the need for a written policy and documentation that says it is safe for 8 hours out of temperature control.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.citation_text: 7-102.11  (Pf) Working spray bottle of clear liquid was not properly labeled. Containers of toxic materials must be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material. Person in charge labeled the container. Reference 7-102.11.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12  (C) Observed a scoop stored in the cormeal with the handle in the cornmeal. The handle was removed during the inspection.
